imoNetZero.sourceNote: IMO Net-Zero Framework, draft MEPC 83 text (approved Apr 2025; adoption targeted MEPC 85, Oct 2026 — PROVISIONAL pending adoption). Reference 93.3 gCO2eq/MJ (2008, WTW). Target ladders agreed 2028-2035 ONLY (base 2040 = 65%, 2036-39 to be set by 2032) - the step function holds the last agreed value flat beyond 2035, a documented approximation. Tier prices $100/$380 per tCO2eq are established for 2028-2030 only and held flat thereafter (provisional). The ZNZ reward rate is genuinely undetermined: no default row - the module reports the surplus balance in tonnes and prices it only via the scenario's optional reward parameter.

speedLaw.note: Power ~ v^3 so GJ/day ~ v^3; nm/day ~ v so GJ/nm ~ v^2. Apply 2.0 to the per-nm figures in energy{}. Applying 3.0 to a per-nm quantity understates by 12% at 11.5 vs 13 kn and 23% at 10 kn.
